research_coverage.method: Problem-contract audit against pinned library implementations, existing author artifacts and targeted publication/repository searches.

algorithms.notes: Public MIT-licensed third-party implementation explicitly based on Lund and Smith. It is not represented as the paper authors original artifact. Dense integer-distance APSP; check infinity sentinel, overflow and block-size assumptions; selected source/destination pairs are extracted from the full matrix.
Entry function FW_GPU. Dense O(n^2) storage; inspect infinity and zero-weight conventions when importing arbitrary graphs.
Entry function R_Kleene. Shares a paper and repository with Floyd-Warshall but is a different APSP algorithm. Dense storage and recursive partition constraints apply.
Real upstream GPU source is present; no implementation-specific paper was verified. Not counted as a code-and-paper pair.
